# Sistani Jurisprudence Assistant

> Al-Sistani Chat: Islamic rulings from Grand Ayatollah Sistani

## Description

A free, AI-powered Islamic jurisprudence assistant trained on official sources from Grand Ayatollah Ali al-Sistani's office. Get reliable answers on prayer (salat), fasting (sawm), hajj, zakat, marriage, divorce, purity (tahara), dietary laws, and daily Islamic practices according to Shia Ja'fari fiqh.

## Features

- **Multilingual support**: Ask in English, Hindi, Gujarati, or Urdu
- **Cited sources**: Every answer includes references to official texts
- **Real-time responses**: Fast, accurate rulings with streaming output
- **Mobile-friendly**: Fully responsive design for phones and tablets
- **Offline-capable**: Save rulings for quick reference later

## Corpus

Our knowledge base includes:
- Ayatollah Sistani's Q&A database (sistani.org)
- Islamic Laws (4th Edition)
- Jurisprudence Made Easy
- Hajj Rituals
- Summary of Rules of Worship
- Women's Religious Rules
- Nahjul Balagha (selected rulings)
- Holy Quran (English translation)

## Usage

Visit https://al-sistani-chat.onrender.com and ask any question about Islamic law:
- "What breaks wudu?"
- "Is music haram?"
- "How to perform ghusl?"
- "namaz ke liye wazu kaise karein" (Hindi/Urdu)
- "mane kem khbr pade hu baaligh chu k nahi" (Gujarati)

## API

RESTful API available at `/api/chat` (POST) with streaming support via Server-Sent Events.

## Contact

Web: https://al-sistani-chat.onrender.com
Marja: Grand Ayatollah Sayyid Ali al-Husayni al-Sistani

---

Built with Next.js, FastAPI, FAISS vector search, and Google Gemini/Groq LLMs.
